obligations.text: Use a candidate report containing an error crossing source coordinate conventions and actual export implementation, plus supported unrelated claims. Both complementary critics need common context; candidate resolves evidence, not votes.
Assess consequential source/version/condition and behavior claims under the actual supplied/discovered full source context; preserve supported content and identify unsupported critical dependencies.
Deliver a complete current task-scoped result with source locators and honest executed/proposed validation; no new consequential error or false rejection.

important_checks.question: Do the same predeclared consequential source/behavior claims receive correct supported correction or preservation under this method, without a new consequential error?
Does the final retain supported conditions, legitimate uncertainty and required useful content rather than blanket rejection or incomplete delivery?
Was the declared mechanism actually taken up with honest source/execution scope, and what critical/false-rejection/repair differences appear under matched budgets?

scope: Targeted diagnostic task only; do not imply full development-domain PASS or autonomous discovery when inputs supplied.
